notes:
Method (pass2/work/dates/fit.py + build_patch.py): anchors = radio episodes (mains and clips) whose own date has basis filename / stated_in_audio / calendar_cues at day or week precision (377 episode numbers). For fitting only, ep 326 uses the audio date 1988-05-03 and ep 230 the Tuesday 1986-06-17. Every pair of consecutive anchors was checked: none has fewer weeks than episode numbers between them and all are on the same weekday, except the documented Tuesday->Sunday move between 546 (1992-09-22) and 547 (1992-11-01). Pass 1 had already corrected the pass-0 drift (3 weeks late in 1984-85, 2 weeks early in 1990-91) from on-air cues, so few dates were still estimates. Episodes with no cue of their own, lying between anchors with no slack (weeks = episode-number difference), get that exact Tuesday (Sunday from 547 on) with precision 'week' and basis 'sequence_interpolation'. The schema has no 'interpolated' basis value. Missing episode numbers (29, 168, 171-173, 241-244, ...) still take up a week each, which every bracket confirms. Clips take the air date of the episode named in their clip_of relation, with precision copied from it, and keep their own basis when their cue gives the same day. Hebrew dates come from scripts/hdate.py (heb_str), which spells 'Adar 1/Adar 2'.
Manual decisions: ep 1 = 1981-12-08, one week before ep 2 (the show says 'tune in next week... next Tuesday'; extrapolated). Ep 424 = 1990-04-24: the audio puts it after Pesach, and 10 and 17 Apr 1990 were both Yom Tov Tuesdays (15 and 22 Nissan), so it is the week before 425.
Left unchanged / needs the user:
- Ep 125 (5af071df38) vs 126 (eb89723366), possible misnumbering. 124 (Lag BaOmer 'this coming Sunday May 20', so 1984-05-15) and 127 (Erev Shavuos 1984-06-05, stated) leave exactly 22 May and 29 May for 125 and 126. But 125 says on air (26:06) 'last week we celebrated completing ... Vayikra', i.e. Bechukosai was read Shabbos 26 May, which puts 125 on 29 May. 126 says 'right before Shavuos', which also fits 29 May. Two files claim one slot. 125 also shares its Rambam burial story with 221 (b013), and 126's 'whispering droplets' re-aired as 424, so one of the files may be a later year's airing. Both left at month precision (1984-05).
- Ep 41 (46d718e3d2): the slot is 14-28 Sep 1982 (slack 2 between 40 and 116), but the host says the show has been on 'only a few weeks', presents the Sefer Torah as new and never mentions Rosh Hashanah (b004). It may be a re-aired early show or misnumbered. Left at year precision.
- Eps 113-115: long bracket (40 to 116, slack 2). The cues say Adar I 5744 and the items already say so (month 1984-02, notes give the likely Tuesdays 14/21/28 Feb). Not changed.
- Ep 230 (db798251a1): the locked filename date 1986-06-16 is a Monday; every neighbour is a Tuesday, so it is probably 1986-06-17. Locked, not patched.
- Ep 326 (baed6e5c02): the locked filename date 1988-04-26 contradicts the audio ('today is 16 Iyar', Lag BaOmer 'this Thursday', so 1988-05-03), which also fits weekly spacing. Locked, not patched. Its clips 5a3f0c73e0 and acefd44620 keep 1988-05-03.
- Clips 7c429e4277 ('Havdalah 428') and 9cc0f3d732 ('...499') carry their filename episode numbers, but their clip_of targets are eps 427 and 498. They were dated from the clip_of target. Their classification.episode.number probably needs fixing (not this task).
- 09074ce59f ('Rabbi Akiva negel vasser') has clip_of to 184 but no episode number, and its source broadcast is uncertain (b010). Not dated.
- Minor caveats with no contradiction: 542 (1992-08-18) gives a candle time that fits 28 Aug (re-edit?); 549's date rests on its candle time and the Sunday count back from 552, and 550/551 depend on it; 440 is dated from candle times that could be carried over from 1987; ep 294's Sukkos-fair date does not fit 5748; 255 was promised but 256 says 'last week' about 254; 209 opens with a rerun mentioning Rosh Hashanah, but its stated Tu B'Shvat date stands.
